definitions.explanation: A state where an event, business, or gathering is bustling and well-attended. Indicates lively success.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|おお}{盛況|せいきょう}だった。
examples.english: The event was a great success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{連日|れんじつ}→連日：14328_renjitsu⟧{盛況|せいきょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The exhibition was bustling every day, with long lines forming.

examples.japanese: {新装|しんそう}⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{盛況|せいきょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: The newly renovated store was packed from day one, and the prepared merchandise sold out quickly.

notes:
USAGE:
Often appears with the prefix {大|おお} as {大盛況|だいせいきょう} (huge success, packed house). Used as a predicate with だ/です: {盛況|せいきょう}だった (it was a great turnout). Also used as a noun modifier: {盛況|せいきょう}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧ (the extent of the success).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}{盛況|せいきょう}: huge success, packed event
- {盛況|せいきょう}のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end successfully
- {盛況|せいきょう}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: the extent of the success
- ⟦{空前|くうぜん}→空前：22320_kuuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛況|せいきょう}: unprecedented success
